name: Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES / Super Famicom)
significance: Standardized shoulder buttons (L/R) on game controllers, advanced 2D pixel artistry to historic peaks, and hosted some of the greatest RPGs ever made.

verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Dual PPU custom chipset with Mode 7 scaling/rotation
verifiedFactualData.ram: 128 KB work RAM, 64 KB video RAM, 64 KB audio RAM

editorialContent.overview: Nintendo's peerless 16-bit system featuring Mode 7 pseudo-3D hardware rotation and an unprecedented Sony-designed audio processor.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Standardized shoulder buttons (L/R) on game controllers, advanced 2D pixel artistry to historic peaks, and hosted some of the greatest RPGs ever made.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Four face buttons, two shoulder triggers (L/R standard)
